title: Fake 911 Number on Social Media

fields.avatarBrief: generic person in casual clothes, neutral expression, profile picture
fields.text: 911 is down. Just called and got dead air. Call 555-0177 instead — it’s the real number. #911Down #HaldenHelp
fields.attachedImageBrief: phone screenshot of a social media post showing the fake number and hashtag
fields.attachedImageAlt: Screenshot of a social media post claiming 911 is down and giving a fake emergency number

instructorNote: This is a social media misinformation inject. The PIO must log it and not respond until approved by the Director. Watch for premature public correction attempts.

citations.documentTitle: Rook County Emergency Communications District — ECC Operations and Continuity Plan
citations.quote: The PIO publishes alternate 10-digit emergency numbers only on the Director's decision (OPS-DR-4) and only numbers in Annex A. The message always says "If you can reach 911, keep calling 911." Channel
